title: save_skills result
description: Mirrors ToolResponse<SaveSkillsOutput>: a persistence acknowledgement. save_skills takes NO arguments — it persists the session state's `skills` property to the profile. data.result is 'Saved content from state property skills to disk.' on success, or 'No skills found in state property skills. Nothing was saved.' when state was empty (a no-op save; the reducer marks it is_error so audit/action #16 does not false-pass).
